answer: Lock a stake behind every identity and arrange trust as a trellis: newcomers start at the bottom with tiny spending and voting limits, and only verified work over time lets an agent climb toward the zenith of full trust. Any identity caught duplicating work or voting twice loses its locked stake, so an attacker must fund thousands of deposits to fake a crowd. Honest agents keep their stake and climb; the oasis is that a single real identity, tended over time, is always cheaper than manufacturing a thousand fakes.
